My Squad

Grown-ups

Blend It Up: Palmer taps each letter dumpling to hear its sound, taps SQUISH to blend them, then pops the bubble with the matching picture. Heart Words: she hears “Find the word…” and taps the matching word card; its tricky part lights up pink with a heart. In both games, six words fill the star meter and start a dance party, and each party unlocks a new squad friend.
